_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); gas distribution and midstream signals with ONEOK's rule-T thresholds

pit_profile.why: 'We are a leading midstream service provider and own one of the nation’s premier natural gas liquids systems, connecting NGL supply in the Mid-Continent, Permian and Rocky Mountain regions with key market centers and an extensive network of natural gas gathering, processing, storage and transportation assets.' 'We operate primarily fee-based businesses in each of our three reportable segments.' 'The volatility of natural gas, crude oil and NGL prices could affect adversely our earnings and cash flows.' (the FY2017 10-K's own words; it does not use the word cyclical, so DURABLE, the MU rule); no disruption theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining': none names gas distribution or midstream), so the watch list is empty; ENERGY_TRANSITION's reserves and refining are out of scope (the TRGP and BKR reading): ONEOK holds no reserves of its own and refines nothing ('We generally contract with crude oil and natural gas producers who have proven reserves or are currently producing natural gas in areas within our existing infrastructure and need gathering and processing services.'); its greenhouse gas risk factor: 'We may face significant costs to comply with the regulation of GHG emissions.' (text only)

(text only). durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 1.17x; +8% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.72; conservative 2yr +51%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -52.9%/yr (worst year FY08-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +9.0%/yr (Q1 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +9.0%/yr (FY08-FY17 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +45.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY08-FY17, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: OKE (retrospective, 2018-05-18) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.17x (89.4% downside to Bear $7 / +76.6% upside to Bull $117) | Adj composite 2.68 vs market 1.96: gap +0.72 [UNDERVALUED] | +8% above the EPP floor $61 (24x FY18E $2.56) | Conservative 2-yr case: +51.4% total (+25.7%/yr) | At 25.9x FY18E the 15% hurdle price $88 sits at or below the BASE case; net margin +21.2% and Distribution operating income n/r in Q1 2018, forward revenues +12.8% (no FY18 revenue guide in numbers, Q1 2018 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream company on this date (CLOUD and OFFSHORE are scoped to IT, ECOMMERCE to retail, STREAMING to TV, ENERGY_TRANSITION to reserves and refining).
